items.title: CISPA European Hackathon Championship
items.summary: Designed and implemented eight challenges in attribution, watermarking, model tracing, and unlearning. Supported participants across seven venues.

items.title: LLM unlearning
items.summary: Evaluated gradient-based unlearning approaches for OLMo-2, examining forgetting, membership inference, and retained model utility.

items.title: QuadTransport
items.summary: Applied quad-tree methods to improve the computational efficiency of Wasserstein distance calculations.

items.title: ML in PL 2026 tutorials
items.summary: Created hands-on challenges and supported participants during the privacy and security in machine learning tutorials.

items.title: Multimodal biometric identification
items.summary: Combined RGB and thermal face images with voice features to explore identification using complementary modalities.

items.title: Trust- and tag-aware recommendations
items.summary: Implemented a research-based recommender on Last.fm, incorporating social trust and user tags to address sparse interactions.

items.title: Intraday trading signals
items.summary: Explored intraday stock modelling with an LSTM and technical indicators, focusing on feature preparation and sequence-based prediction.
